target_customer: Hospital NICUs and their nursing staff
problem: NICU nurses spend whole shifts defrosting frozen breast milk and hospitals discard milk under strict rules, wasting time and supply.
product_category: Medical device for human milk processing

founders.name: Vansh Langer
founders.background_notes: Physician (MD) per YC page. TechCrunch says he developed the two-factor laser device.

founders.name: Blanca Rosa Aguilar Uscanga
founders.background_notes: PhD in bioengineering and food science per YC page.

competitors.name: Milkify
competitors.what: Freeze-drying service turning frozen breast milk into powder for consumers, including NICU families
competitors.traction_then: Founded 2019, later appeared on Shark Tank
competitors.funding_then: CB Insights lists $3.74M total, date unknown

technical_complexity.rationale: Preserving immunological activity while condensing milk needs novel process science and a medical-grade device. Research is peer reviewed and used in hospitals.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary condensing process with published research and hospital validation; regulatory pathways raise entry barriers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copying found. Other firms pursue donor milk powders or consumer freeze-drying.

market_need_then: NICUs face the 'milk shift' where nurses defrost milk for the next shift, plus waste from discard rules. The company says 20 hospitals in the New York Tri-State already used it.

branding.domain_note: Uses bbymilk.com. Aggregators also reference bbyworld.com. No history found.
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch, The Hustle, Medgadget and Yahoo as a novel NICU device

brand_strength.rationale: Press coverage across TechCrunch and others and a baby-evoking short name, but no community or merch evidence.

outcome_analysis: BBy bootstrapped for about seven years from 2015, joined YC in Winter 2022 and raised a $3M seed led by Pioneer Fund in 2023. Its physician and food-science PhD founders built a research-backed process with hospital use. No later round was found, so it stays early stage with a regulated product and a slow hospital sales cycle.
notes: Seed reported by TechCrunch, SoFi and R&D World, with TechCrunch dating the raise as 2022 in one passage and May 2023 in the article date, so 2023-05 is used. The company site returned 503 when fetched. Stage Growth in the directory is not supported by sources. Milkify source is an undated aggregator and Milkify is consumer-focused, so it is only a partial rival. No shutdown or acquisition found.
